extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data quality issues: (1) Standardized species labels (Adelie, Gentoo) with case and spacing variants; (2) Corrected misspelled island 'Bisco' to 'Biscoe'; (3) Converted body_mass_g from text with commas to numeric; (4) Excluded 3 rows with impossible body mass values (3.8M, 5M, 4.4M grams) as likely data entry errors. After fixes, the average body mass is 3,768.48 g for Adelie, 3,680.00 g for Chinstrap, and 5,303.57 g for Gentoo penguins.
